title: The Pope Between Two Fires
sentences: When the plague reached Avignon, the Pope had a strategy.
Pope Clement the Sixth sat between two huge fires.
His doctor believed the heat would purify the poisoned air.
Some think it actually helped, since fleas avoid intense heat.
Our full Black Death documentary is out today on YouTube.
